title: LuaEventEntry
description: One line in LUA_EVENTS_FILE (default /run/crowdsec-lua/events.jsonl). Written by the OpenResty Lua layer, consumed by read_lua_events() + process_lua_events() in Python. The file is consumed atomically via rename (events.jsonl → events.jsonl.processing); Lua recreates it after the rename. Malformed lines are silently skipped.

type.description: Event type. 'honeypot_hit': request to a honeypot path. 'heuristic_escalate': Lua score threshold exceeded.

ip.description: Client IPv4 or IPv6 address. Empty or missing entries are silently dropped by process_lua_events().

score.description: Lua-computed threat score. For 'heuristic_escalate', AbuseIPDB report is sent only when score >= 90.

detail.description: Optional human-readable detail (e.g. honeypot path, matched rule). Included in AbuseIPDB comment.
